## Navigating Latest Tariff Developments

Global trade is becoming increasingly complex as new U.S. tariffs and varying reciprocal measures
emerge across countries and industries. At DHL, we are committed to helping you navigate these
changes.

[ Explore Our U.S. Tariff Solutions ][72]

## Document and Parcel Shipping

For All Shippers

Learn about DHL Express – the undisputed global leader in international express shipping.

### Services Available
* Next Possible Business Day
* Flexible Import/Export Options
* Tailored Business Solutions
* Wide Variety of Optional Services

[ Explore DHL Express ][73]

## Cargo Shipping

Business Only

Discover shipping and logistics service options from DHL Global Forwarding.

### Services Available
* Air Freight
* Road Freight
* Ocean Freight
* Rail Freight

[ Explore DHL Global Forwarding ][74]

## Enterprise Logistics Services

Business Only

Find out how DHL Supply Chain can revolutionize your business as a 3PL provider.

### Solutions Available
* Warehousing
* Transport
* Packaging
* Service Logistics
* Real Estate
* And more!

[ Explore DHL Supply Chain ][75]

## DHL for Your Business

Power your small and medium-sized business success with world-class shipping and logistics. Our team
of experts can help you address the ever changing need of your customers.

[ Explore Our Business Solutions ][76]

## Important Service Updates

Service bulletins keep you up to date with news and alerts
* [ New Customs Rules for Shipments Under €150 From Outside the EU Starting July 1, 2026 ][77]
* [ Operational Update Middle East ][78]

## Sustainability

Sustainable business begins with low carbon supply chains. Find out what we have to offer and how we
integrate sustainability into our operations to reduce environmental impacts for your supply chain. 

][79]
[

## Innovation

Discover the future of logistics through customer-centric innovation, industry-leading trend
research and next generation solutions.

][80]
[

## Globalization holds firm at a record level

The DHL Global Connectedness Report 2026 offers the most comprehensive view of globalization
available.

][81]

## Eco Wave Power (NASDAQ: WAVE) - Converting Ocean Waves into Scalable Energy Infrastructure

Eco Wave Power Global (NASDAQ: WAVE) is a leading onshore wave energy company that converts ocean
and sea waves into clean, reliable, and cost-efficient electricity using its patented and
intelligent technology. By generating renewable power directly from existing coastal infrastructure
such as breakwaters, jetties, and piers, Eco Wave Power enables sustainable electricity production
in close proximity to coastal cities, ports, and energy-intensive infrastructure.

As global electricity demand continues to rise with the growth of artificial intelligence, digital
infrastructure, and next-generation data centers—often referred to as “AI factories”—Eco Wave
Power’s technology is designed to help provide renewable energy near shorelines where many data
centers, industrial facilities, and population centers are located.

With a mission to accelerate the global transition to renewable energy while supporting the next
generation of digital and industrial infrastructure, Eco Wave Power developed and operates Israel’s
first grid-connected wave energy power station, recognized as a “Pioneering Technology” by the
Israeli Ministry of Energy and co-funded by EDF Power Solutions. In the United States, the Company
recently launched the first-ever onshore wave energy pilot station at the Port of Los Angeles, in
collaboration with Shell Marine Renewable Energy.

Eco Wave Power is expanding globally with projects planned in Portugal, Taiwan, and India,
representing a project pipeline of 404.7 MW. The Company has received international recognition and
support from organizations including the European Union Regional Development Fund, Innovate UK, and
the EU Horizon 2020 program, and was honored with the United Nations Global Climate Action Award.

Eco Wave Power’s American Depositary Shares (ADSs) are traded on the Nasdaq Capital Market under the
ticker symbol **“WAVE.”**

## Eco Wave Power (NASDAQ: WAVE) - Converting Ocean Waves into Scalable Energy Infrastructure

Eco Wave Power Global (NASDAQ: WAVE) is a leading onshore wave energy company that converts ocean
and sea waves into clean, reliable, and cost-efficient electricity using its patented and
intelligent technology. By generating renewable power directly from existing coastal infrastructure
such as breakwaters, jetties, and piers, Eco Wave Power enables sustainable electricity production
in close proximity to coastal cities, ports, and energy-intensive infrastructure.

As global electricity demand continues to rise with the growth of artificial intelligence, digital
infrastructure, and next-generation data centers—often referred to as “AI factories”—Eco Wave
Power’s technology is designed to help provide renewable energy near shorelines where many data
centers, industrial facilities, and population centers are located.

With a mission to accelerate the global transition to renewable energy while supporting the next
generation of digital and industrial infrastructure, Eco Wave Power developed and operates Israel’s
first grid-connected wave energy power station, recognized as a “Pioneering Technology” by the
Israeli Ministry of Energy and co-funded by EDF Power Solutions. In the United States, the Company
recently launched the first-ever onshore wave energy pilot station at the Port of Los Angeles, in
collaboration with Shell Marine Renewable Energy.

Eco Wave Power is expanding globally with projects planned in Portugal, Taiwan, and India,
representing a project pipeline of 404.7 MW. The Company has received international recognition and
support from organizations including the European Union Regional Development Fund, Innovate UK, and
the EU Horizon 2020 program, and was honored with the United Nations Global Climate Action Award.

Eco Wave Power’s American Depositary Shares (ADSs) are traded on the Nasdaq Capital Market under the
ticker symbol **“WAVE.”**

## Why We Do 
## What We Do

AVS was established to serve the growing demand for musical instruments and professional audio
solutions across the GCC.

As a dedicated distribution company, AVS partners with top-tier brands to ensure quality,
reliability, and accessibility for retailers and professionals in the region. Our commitment goes
beyond supplying products—we focus on delivering exceptional service, strong brand representation,
and long-term market growth.

[AVS is your go-to partner for top-tier studio equipment in GCC.]
[AVS warehouse is located in Jebel Ali Freezone, Dubai, U.A.E]

## Building a reliable distribution network 

by partnering with dealers across the Middle East, GCC, Africa, and CIS regions

1

### Musical Instruments

GUITARS | DRUMS | BASS | AMP & EFFECTS | BAND & ORCHESTRA | KEYBOARDS | PIANOS

Supplying a full range of musical instruments from globally trusted brands to dealers across the
region — including music retailers, educational institutions, rental companies, and more. Our dealer
network is backed by bilingual (Arabic & English) technical support, product training, and reliable
after-sales service, ensuring a seamless experience for our partners.

[DSC00258.jpg]

2

### Live Sound

LOUDSPEAKERS | MIXERS | DJ | AUDIO CABLES | MICROPHONES | CABLE CONNECTORS

Professional-grade live sound equipment solutions tailored for today’s touring professionals, venue
integrators, houses of worship, and more. With logistics designed for speed and consistency, we
ensure our partners get the gear they need, when and where it matters most.

[Thump210Xt Lifestyle21-PNG_FullRes.png]

3

### Studio Equipment

STUDIO MONITORS | PODCAST/STREAMING | RECORDING | HEADPHONES | STUDIO ACCESSORIES

Your go-to partner for top-tier studio equipment in the region. We offer high-demand products
trusted by resellers, renowned recording studios, production companies, and more. With seamless
logistics and expert support, we help our partners maintain smooth, reliable operations across every
level of audio production.

[DSC09809.jpg]

## Our Brands Portfolio

With a deep commitment to the music and sound landscape of the MEA and African regions, we are
partnered with the finest global brands, ensuring our partners can consistently rely on premium
distribution.

ensure our partners get the gear they need, when and where it matters most.

logistics and expert support, we help our partners maintain smooth, reliable operations across every
level of audio production.

[DSC09809.jpg]

# We Build the Platforms That Make GCC Corporate Commerce Faster, Cheaper, and More Transparent.

Bloom Techno FZE-LLC is a licensed technology company that designs, builds, and operates
institutional platforms. Our first platform, Sijil, is the region's corporate setup aggregator and
transaction clearinghouse — serving founders, free zones, and corporate service providers across the
UAE.

[Explore Sijil][9][Learn About Us][10]

Flagship Platform

## Sijil — The Skyscanner of GCC Business Setup

Sijil — meaning "registry" in Arabic

Sijil is a free, neutral comparison engine covering 46+ UAE jurisdictions. Founders enter their
business activity, visa needs, and nationality — and instantly see real government baseline fees,
banking approval odds, corporate tax classification, and processing times, side by side across every
relevant free zone and mainland option. No bias. No hidden fees. No agency pushing one option over
another.

teams and deep expertise. We manage supplier verification, quality checks, logistics, and paperwork

At GCC, we build relationships beyond logistics, offering clarity, structure, and hands-on support,
becoming an extension of your business. Whether you're a manufacturer going global or a buyer

# LLM Wiki

A pattern for building personal knowledge bases using LLMs.

This is an idea file, it is designed to be copy pasted to your own LLM Agent (e.g. OpenAI Codex,
Claude Code, OpenCode / Pi, or etc.). Its goal is to communicate the high level idea, but your agent
will build out the specifics in collaboration with you.

## The core idea

Most people's experience with LLMs and documents looks like RAG: you upload a collection of files,
the LLM retrieves relevant chunks at query time, and generates an answer. This works, but the LLM is
rediscovering knowledge from scratch on every question. There's no accumulation. Ask a subtle
question that requires synthesizing five documents, and the LLM has to find and piece together the
relevant fragments every time. Nothing is built up. NotebookLM, ChatGPT file uploads, and most RAG
systems work this way.

# LLM Wiki

A pattern for building personal knowledge bases using LLMs.

This is an idea file, it is designed to be copy pasted to your own LLM Agent (e.g. OpenAI Codex,
Claude Code, OpenCode / Pi, or etc.). Its goal is to communicate the high level idea, but your agent
will build out the specifics in collaboration with you.

## The core idea

Most people's experience with LLMs and documents looks like RAG: you upload a collection of files,
the LLM retrieves relevant chunks at query time, and generates an answer. This works, but the LLM is
rediscovering knowledge from scratch on every question. There's no accumulation. Ask a subtle
question that requires synthesizing five documents, and the LLM has to find and piece together the
relevant fragments every time. Nothing is built up. NotebookLM, ChatGPT file uploads, and most RAG
systems work this way.

## **Your strategic gateway to private market access in the GCC.**

Gulf Equity Partners is a UAE-based private placement advisory firm working exclusively with
institutional and professional investors across the Gulf region. Our counterparties include
sovereign wealth funds, family offices, pension institutions, and accredited investors with mandates
across asset classes and geographies.

We specialize in making informed introductions to select financial opportunities spanning private
equity, private credit, venture capital, and other alternative investment structures. These
engagements are centered around thoughtfully structured offerings designed to align with the
long-term strategies of sophisticated investors.

With deep regional insight and a global vantage point, we serve as a trusted conduit between
investment platforms and the capital community, always guided by discretion, precision, and a strong
understanding of the evolving market landscape.


## Our Mission

At Gulf Equity Partners, our mission is to cultivate strategic relationships between professional
investors and thoughtfully structured financial opportunities. Headquartered in the United Arab
Emirates, we focus exclusively on making introductions and promoting financial products in a manner
consistent with regulatory standards.

We engage with a trusted network of institutional and professional investors — including family
offices, sovereign entities, and asset managers — across the UAE and broader GCC region. Our
platform spans sectors such as private equity, infrastructure, technology, data centres, logistics,
and real estate-backed financial structures.

By combining deep regional insight with a carefully curated network, we provide our clients with a
clear, informed pathway to meaningful market access. Our work is guided by discretion, transparency,
and a commitment to operating within the defined scope of our activities.

At Gulf Equity, we believe the strength of a relationship is the best measure of success.


## ***Built for Strategic Growth***

Gulf Equity Partners operates at the intersection of opportunity and insight, with deep
relationships across the UAE and wider GCC investment landscape. Our approach is grounded in trust,
discretion, and long-term alignment, connecting clients with institutional capital and structured
financial solutions tailored to their unique mandates.

We work across a broad spectrum of investment sectors, from alternative assets and real estate
investment structures to technology, infrastructure, and growth-stage platforms. Our role is
enabling engagement between sophisticated capital and curated opportunities via exempt and regulated
structures.

At Gulf Equity, we view every client relationship as part of a long-term partnership. Our network is
built on over a decade of market experience and grows through selective, high-integrity
collaboration. We build enduring bridges between our clients and opportunity.

Our vision is to contribute meaningfully to the region’s evolving investment ecosystem, constantly
innovating, adapting, and refining how we support the next generation of financial partnerships in
the GCC.

## **Your strategic gateway to private market access in the GCC.**

Gulf Equity Partners is a UAE-based private placement advisory firm working exclusively with
institutional and professional investors across the Gulf region. Our counterparties include
sovereign wealth funds, family offices, pension institutions, and accredited investors with mandates
across asset classes and geographies.

We specialize in making informed introductions to select financial opportunities spanning private
equity, private credit, venture capital, and other alternative investment structures. These
engagements are centered around thoughtfully structured offerings designed to align with the
long-term strategies of sophisticated investors.

With deep regional insight and a global vantage point, we serve as a trusted conduit between
investment platforms and the capital community, always guided by discretion, precision, and a strong
understanding of the evolving market landscape.


## Our Mission

At Gulf Equity Partners, our mission is to cultivate strategic relationships between professional
investors and thoughtfully structured financial opportunities. Headquartered in the United Arab
Emirates, we focus exclusively on making introductions and promoting financial products in a manner
consistent with regulatory standards.

We engage with a trusted network of institutional and professional investors — including family
offices, sovereign entities, and asset managers — across the UAE and broader GCC region. Our
platform spans sectors such as private equity, infrastructure, technology, data centres, logistics,
and real estate-backed financial structures.

By combining deep regional insight with a carefully curated network, we provide our clients with a
clear, informed pathway to meaningful market access. Our work is guided by discretion, transparency,
and a commitment to operating within the defined scope of our activities.

At Gulf Equity, we believe the strength of a relationship is the best measure of success.


## ***Built for Strategic Growth***

Gulf Equity Partners operates at the intersection of opportunity and insight, with deep
relationships across the UAE and wider GCC investment landscape. Our approach is grounded in trust,
discretion, and long-term alignment, connecting clients with institutional capital and structured
financial solutions tailored to their unique mandates.

We work across a broad spectrum of investment sectors, from alternative assets and real estate
investment structures to technology, infrastructure, and growth-stage platforms. Our role is
enabling engagement between sophisticated capital and curated opportunities via exempt and regulated
structures.

At Gulf Equity, we view every client relationship as part of a long-term partnership. Our network is
built on over a decade of market experience and grows through selective, high-integrity
collaboration. We build enduring bridges between our clients and opportunity.

Our vision is to contribute meaningfully to the region’s evolving investment ecosystem, constantly
innovating, adapting, and refining how we support the next generation of financial partnerships in
the GCC.

# Install C  

Fast and Simple One-Click Installer
for the entire C development toolchain.

[Download][12]

## What's in Install C?

### One-Click Installer

Simple and easy to use, yet powerful and feature-rich.

[One-Click Installer]

### Latest Version of GCC

The only installer to include the latest version of GCC (13.2.0) 2023 on Windows.

[Latest Version of GCC]

### Compatibility with VS Code

Simply open a new .c file in VS Code and hit Run.

[Compatibility with VS Code]

### Run Everywhere

Automatic addition to Path, no messing with Environment Variables required.

### Compatibility with Code Runner

To skip the lag-inducing process and execute your code faster, use the [CodeRunner][13] extension!

### Powerful enough for Veterans. Simple enough for Beginners.

Install C provides the very latest version of GCC for Power-Users who want the latest features, and
it is still easy enough to use for those writing their first line of C.

### Multi-Language Made Easy

Not just C, even works for C++. Though the priority of this project is C Language Programming.

### And Much More...

GCC, GDB, LLVM/Clang/LLD/LLDB, GNU Binutils, GNU Make, PExports, dos2unix, Yasm, NASM, JWasm,
ccache, CMake, ninja, and Doxygen are included in Install C.

# Install C  

Fast and Simple One-Click Installer
for the entire C development toolchain.

[Download][12]

## What's in Install C?

### One-Click Installer

Simple and easy to use, yet powerful and feature-rich.

[One-Click Installer]

### Latest Version of GCC

The only installer to include the latest version of GCC (13.2.0) 2023 on Windows.

[Latest Version of GCC]

### Compatibility with VS Code

Simply open a new .c file in VS Code and hit Run.

[Compatibility with VS Code]

### Run Everywhere

Automatic addition to Path, no messing with Environment Variables required.

### Compatibility with Code Runner

To skip the lag-inducing process and execute your code faster, use the [CodeRunner][13] extension!

### Powerful enough for Veterans. Simple enough for Beginners.

Install C provides the very latest version of GCC for Power-Users who want the latest features, and
it is still easy enough to use for those writing their first line of C.

### Multi-Language Made Easy

Not just C, even works for C++. Though the priority of this project is C Language Programming.

### And Much More...

GCC, GDB, LLVM/Clang/LLD/LLDB, GNU Binutils, GNU Make, PExports, dos2unix, Yasm, NASM, JWasm,
ccache, CMake, ninja, and Doxygen are included in Install C.

What is Trudian?

## B2B Video Intercom & Smart Lock Manufacturer — CE · FCC · RoHS · ISO 9001

Trudian is a CE, FCC, RoHS and ISO 9001 certified B2B manufacturer and OEM/ODM supplier and
wholesale supplier of IP video intercom doorbells and smart locks, serving distributors, system
integrators, property developers, and hotel groups across the United States, Europe (UK, Germany,
France, Italy, Spain), and the Middle East (UAE, Saudi Arabia, Qatar, Kuwait). Founded in 2014 and
operating a 30,000 m² ISO 9001-certified factory in Zhongshan, Guangdong, China, Trudian offers OEM
manufacturing from 500 units and ODM deep customization from 1,000 units with full CE/FCC/RoHS
certification support, and English, Arabic, and German technical documentation. The global video
intercom market is valued at USD 3.07 billion in 2026, with the smart lock market at USD 3.29
billion — both growing at 10%+ CAGR.

Mingw-w64 is a collection of header files, import libraries, libraries and tools that, when combined
with a compiler toolchain, such as GCC or LLVM, provides a complete development environment for
building native Windows applications and libraries.

Mingw-w64 is an advancement of the original mingw.org project, which was created to support the GCC
compiler on Windows systems. It was forked in 2007 in order to provide 64-bit support and newer
APIs. It has since then gained wide use and distribution.

**Headers and Libraries:**
* More than a million lines of headers are provided, not counting generated ones, and regularly
  expanded to track new Windows APIs.
* Everything needed for linking and running your code on Windows.
* Better-conforming and faster math support compared to VisualStudio's.

**Runtime Libraries:**
* Winpthreads, a pthreads library for C++11 threading support and simple integration with existing
  project.
* Winstorecompat, a work-in-progress convenience library that eases conformance with the Windows
  Store.

**Tools:**
* gendef: generate Visual Studio .def files from .dll files.
* genidl: generate .idl files from .dll files.
* widl: compile .idl files.

## Project Collaborations

Mingw-w64 interacts a lot with other projects in order to help everyone move forward. Contributions
have been going to and coming from these projects:

Mingw-w64 is a collection of header files, import libraries, libraries and tools that, when combined
with a compiler toolchain, such as GCC or LLVM, provides a complete development environment for
building native Windows applications and libraries.

Mingw-w64 is an advancement of the original mingw.org project, which was created to support the GCC
compiler on Windows systems. It was forked in 2007 in order to provide 64-bit support and newer
APIs. It has since then gained wide use and distribution.

**Headers and Libraries:**
* More than a million lines of headers are provided, not counting generated ones, and regularly
  expanded to track new Windows APIs.
* Everything needed for linking and running your code on Windows.
* Better-conforming and faster math support compared to VisualStudio's.

**Runtime Libraries:**
* Winpthreads, a pthreads library for C++11 threading support and simple integration with existing
  project.
* Winstorecompat, a work-in-progress convenience library that eases conformance with the Windows
  Store.

**Tools:**
* gendef: generate Visual Studio .def files from .dll files.
* genidl: generate .idl files from .dll files.
* widl: compile .idl files.

Mingw-w64 interacts a lot with other projects in order to help everyone move forward. Contributions

# MSYS2

## Software Distribution and Building Platform for Windows


**MSYS2** is a collection of tools and libraries providing you with an easy-to-use environment for
building, installing and running native Windows software.

It consists of a command line terminal called [mintty][84], bash, version control systems like git
and subversion, tools like tar and awk and even build systems like autotools, all based on a
modified version of [Cygwin][85]. Despite some of these central parts being based on Cygwin, the
main focus of MSYS2 is to provide a build environment for native Windows software and the
Cygwin-using parts are kept at a minimum. MSYS2 provides up-to-date native builds for GCC,
mingw-w64, CPython, CMake, Meson, OpenSSL, FFmpeg, Rust, Ruby, just to name a few.

To provide easy installation of packages and a way to keep them updated it features a package
management system called [Pacman][86], which should be familiar to Arch Linux users. It brings many
powerful features such as dependency resolution and simple complete system upgrades, as well as
straight-forward and reproducible package building. Our package repository contains [more than 3700
pre-built packages][87] ready to install.

For more details see ['What is MSYS2?'][88] which also compares MSYS2 to other software
distributions and development environments like [Cygwin][89], [WSL][90], [Chocolatey][91],
[Scoop][92], ... and ['Who Is Using MSYS2?'][93] to see which projects are using MSYS2 and what for.

## Installation
1. Download the installer:
   
   [ msys2-x86_64-20260611.exe][94] or [ msys2-arm64-20260611.exe][95] (ARM64)
   
   (Optional) For more information on the installer, like command line options, or how to verify the
   checksum and signature of the installer, see the [installer guide][96].
2. Run the installer. Installing MSYS2 requires 64 bit Windows 10 (1809+) or newer.
3. Enter your desired **Installation Folder**. We recommend using the default, see [installation
   folder recommendations][97] for more information.
   
   [Second screen of MSYS2 installation] [Second screen of MSYS2 installation]
4. When done, click **Finish**.
   
   [Third screen of MSYS2 installation] [Third screen of MSYS2 installation]
5. Now MSYS2 is ready for you and a terminal for the [UCRT64 environment][98] will launch.
   
   [Empty MSYS2 terminal window] [Empty MSYS2 terminal window]
6. You will probably want to install some tools like the mingw-w64 GCC to start compiling projects.
   Run the following command:
   
   `$ pacman -S

## Installation
1. Download the installer:
   
   [ msys2-x86_64-20260611.exe][94] or [ msys2-arm64-20260611.exe][95] (ARM64)

2. Run the installer. Installing MSYS2 requires 64 bit Windows 10 (1809+) or newer.
3. Enter your desired **Installation Folder**. We recommend using the default, see [installation
   folder recommendations][97] for more information.

6. You will probably want to install some tools like the mingw-w64 GCC to start compiling projects.
   Run the following command:
   
   `$ pacman -S mingw-w64-ucrt-x86_64-gcc
   `
7. The terminal window will show the output as below. Press 'Enter' to continue:

               mingw-w64-ucrt-x86_64-mpc-1.3.1-2  mingw-w64-ucrt-x86_64-mpfr-4.2.1-2
               mingw-w64-ucrt-x86_64-windows-default-manifest-6.4-4
               mingw-w64-ucrt-x86_64-winpthreads-git-11.0.0.r216.gffe883434-1
               mingw-w64-ucrt-x86_64-zlib-1.3-1  mingw-w64-ucrt-x86_64-zstd-1.5.5-1
               mingw-w64-ucrt-x86_64-gcc-13.2.0-2
   
   Total Download Size:    49.38 MiB
   Total Installed Size:  418.82 MiB
   
   :: Proceed with installation? [Y/n]
   [... downloading and installation continues ...]

8. Now you can call `gcc` to build software for Windows.

   gcc.exe (Rev2, Built by MSYS2 project) 13.2.0
   `

   information.

# MSYS2

## Software Distribution and Building Platform for Windows


**MSYS2** is a collection of tools and libraries providing you with an easy-to-use environment for
building, installing and running native Windows software.

It consists of a command line terminal called [mintty][84], bash, version control systems like git
and subversion, tools like tar and awk and even build systems like autotools, all based on a
modified version of [Cygwin][85]. Despite some of these central parts being based on Cygwin, the
main focus of MSYS2 is to provide a build environment for native Windows software and the
Cygwin-using parts are kept at a minimum. MSYS2 provides up-to-date native builds for GCC,
mingw-w64, CPython, CMake, Meson, OpenSSL, FFmpeg, Rust, Ruby, just to name a few.

To provide easy installation of packages and a way to keep them updated it features a package
management system called [Pacman][86], which should be familiar to Arch Linux users. It brings many
powerful features such as dependency resolution and simple complete system upgrades, as well as
straight-forward and reproducible package building. Our package repository contains [more than 3700
pre-built packages][87] ready to install.

For more details see ['What is MSYS2?'][88] which also compares MSYS2 to other software
distributions and development environments like [Cygwin][89], [WSL][90], [Chocolatey][91],
[Scoop][92], ... and ['Who Is Using MSYS2?'][93] to see which projects are using MSYS2 and what for.

## Installation
1. Download the installer:
   
   [ msys2-x86_64-20260611.exe][94] or [ msys2-arm64-20260611.exe][95] (ARM64)
   
   (Optional) For more information on the installer, like command line options, or how to verify the
   checksum and signature of the installer, see the [installer guide][96].
2. Run the installer. Installing MSYS2 requires 64 bit Windows 10 (1809+) or newer.
3. Enter your desired **Installation Folder**. We recommend using the default, see [installation
   folder recommendations][97] for more information.
   
   [Second screen of MSYS2 installation] [Second screen of MSYS2 installation]
4. When done, click **Finish**.
   
   [Third screen of MSYS2 installation] [Third screen of MSYS2 installation]
5. Now MSYS2 is ready for you and a terminal for the [UCRT64 environment][98] will launch.
   
   [Empty MSYS2 terminal window] [Empty MSYS2 terminal window]
6. You will probably want to install some tools like the mingw-w64 GCC to start compiling projects.
   Run the following command:
   
   `$ pacman -S mingw-w64-ucrt-x86_64-gcc
   `
7. The terminal window will show the output as below. Press 'Enter' to continue:
   
   `resolving dependencies...
   looking for conflicting packages...
   
   Packages (15) mingw-w64-ucrt-x86_64-binutils-2.41-2
               mingw-w64-ucrt-x86_64-crt-git-11.0.0.r216.gffe883434-1
               mingw-w64-ucrt-x86_64-gcc-libs-13.2.0-2  mingw-w64-ucrt-x86_64-gmp-6.3.0-2
               mingw-w64-ucrt-x86_64-headers-git-11.0.0.r216.gffe883434-1
               mingw-w64-ucrt-x86_64-isl-0.26-1  mingw-w64-ucrt-x86_64-libiconv-1.17-3
               mingw-w64-ucrt-x86_64-libwinpthread-git-11.0.0.r216.gffe883434-1
               mingw-w64-ucrt-x86_64-mpc-1.3.1-2  mingw-w64-ucrt-x86_64-mpfr-4.2.1-2
               mingw-w64-ucrt-x86_64-windows-default-manifest-6.4-4
               mingw-w64-ucrt-x86_64-winpthreads-git-11.0.0.r216.gffe883434-1
               mingw-w64-ucrt-x86_64-zlib-1.3-1  mingw-w64-ucrt-x86_64-zstd-1.5.5-1
               mingw-w64-ucrt-x86_64-gcc-13.2.0-2
   
   Total Download Size:    49.38 MiB
   Total Installed Size:  418.82 MiB
   
   :: Proceed with installation? [Y/n]
   [... downloading and installation continues ...]
   `
8. Now you can call `gcc` to build software for Windows.
   
   `$ gcc --version
   gcc.exe (Rev2, Built by MSYS2 project) 13.2.0
   `
9. After installing MSYS2 it will update itself via `pacman`, see the [update guide][99] for more
   information.

## From Nasscom

#### India’s Next Energy Revolution

**#Sustainability**

India’s AI-driven energy demand is accelerating green hydrogen adoption, targeting 5 million tonnes
by 2030 for energy security.

**KEY TAKEAWAYS**
* AI-driven computing and data centers are reshaping electricity demand, creating unprecedented
  pressure on energy infrastructure and supply.
* Intermittent solar and wind power make large-scale energy storage essential for grid stability and
  efficient utilization.
* Green hydrogen offers India a path to decarbonization, energy independence, and replacing most
  gray hydrogen by 2030.
[ LEARN MORE ][76]

#### Charting the Future: AI and Global Power

**#AIregulation**

As AI reshapes geopolitics and great-power rivalry, global cooperation is crucial to ensure
responsible development and governance.

**KEY TAKEAWAYS**
* AI is rapidly reshaping geopolitics, amplifying great power rivalries and creating new risks to
  global stability.
* Intensifying competition among nations makes collaborative AI governance difficult, increasing
  fears of dangerous superintelligence development.
* Global leaders and businesses must urgently coordinate AI regulation to prevent catastrophic
  misuse and weaponization.
[ LEARN MORE ][77]

#### Leading Through People: A BPM Leadership Story

**#FutureOfWork**

Kalpak Huddar of Foundever highlights the BPM industry as a dynamic career path, emphasizing
upskilling, growth, leadership, and future-ready talent.

**KEY TAKEAWAYS**
* India’s CX industry has evolved from cost-driven outsourcing into a people-centric ecosystem
  delivering value, innovation, and business transformation.
* Continuous upskilling and rapid internal mobility make the CX sector a powerful engine for
  leadership development.
* Beyond business impact, the CX industry drives inclusion, employability, and meaningful social
  progress through people-first growth.
[ LEARN MORE ][78]

#### The Future of CX: An AI Story

**#AIForCX**

EXL’s Smart Agent Assist uses Gen AI to boost compliance, resolutions, and CX across 20M-plus
customer service interactions globally.

**KEY TAKEAWAYS**
* EXL’s Smart Agent Assist uses generative AI to deliver real-time guidance, improving compliance
  and first-call resolution.
* Speech-to-text, automated summaries, and AI-driven audits reduce call times while enhancing
  customer experience efficiency.
* Handling over 20 million calls, EXL plans to scale Smart Agent Assist beyond 50 million.

About OASIS

## Onward Alliance for Stability and Inclusive Solutions

[ [About OASIS] ][41]

**OASIS (Onward Alliance for Stability and Inclusive Solutions)** is a pioneering initiative led by
DeepRoot Solutions Management Consulting. Our mission is to enhance regional stability and
cooperation by empowering emerging leaders from Yemen, the Gulf, and the broader region. Our project
focuses on bridging communication gaps among these leaders, fostering their leadership development,
and encouraging collaborative policymaking to address shared regional challenges.

OASIS distinguishes itself as a structured platform for emerging leaders under 40, filling a
critical gap in traditional regional programs by actively involving youth voices in discussions
concerning economic cooperation and mutual concerns between Yemen and its neighboring countries. We
are committed to equipping participants with the essential knowledge, networks, and actionable tools
necessary to contribute to long-term peace, stability, and development across the region.

Read Our Key Objectives
Key Objectives

### What We Aim to Achieve

Through four in-person forums, a secure digital networking platform, and extensive public opinion
engagement, OASIS aims to achieve the following key objectives:
* **Promote Regional Dialogue and Collaboration:** Host forums to engage participants on vital
  topics including the blue economy, policy, trade, leadership, and governance.
* **Develop Leadership Skills:** Offer advanced training, mentorship, and public leadership
  development opportunities.
* **Address Pressing Regional Issues:** Produce actionable solutions such as policy proposals, joint
  research, articles, and public awareness campaigns.
* **Provide a Sustainable Networking Platform:** Launch an online hub to support ongoing engagement
  and collaborative projects.

By the Numbers

Blue Economy [ Entrepreneurship and Youth Participation in the Blue Economy in Yemen, GCC Countries,
and Red Sea Littoral States ][42]

The sustainable Blue Economy represents a critical strategic opportunity for Yemen, GCC countries,
and the Red Sea littoral states. At a time when GCC countries are seeking to diversify their
economies away from reliance on oil, the Blue Economy emerges as a vital lifeline for livelihoods
and food security in Yemen, and a key economic leverage for the Red Sea littoral states. Youth in
these regions possess immense potential to lead this transformation, driven by a growing awareness
of sustainability issues and their advanced digital skills.

## Onward Alliance for Stability and Inclusive Solutions

[ [About OASIS] ][41]

**OASIS (Onward Alliance for Stability and Inclusive Solutions)** is a pioneering initiative led by
DeepRoot Solutions Management Consulting. Our mission is to enhance regional stability and
cooperation by empowering emerging leaders from Yemen, the Gulf, and the broader region. Our project
focuses on bridging communication gaps among these leaders, fostering their leadership development,
and encouraging collaborative policymaking to address shared regional challenges.

OASIS distinguishes itself as a structured platform for emerging leaders under 40, filling a
critical gap in traditional regional programs by actively involving youth voices in discussions
concerning economic cooperation and mutual concerns between Yemen and its neighboring countries. We
are committed to equipping participants with the essential knowledge, networks, and actionable tools
necessary to contribute to long-term peace, stability, and development across the region.

Read Our Key Objectives
Key Objectives

### What We Aim to Achieve

Through four in-person forums, a secure digital networking platform, and extensive public opinion
engagement, OASIS aims to achieve the following key objectives:
* **Promote Regional Dialogue and Collaboration:** Host forums to engage participants on vital
  topics including the blue economy, policy, trade, leadership, and governance.
* **Develop Leadership Skills:** Offer advanced training, mentorship, and public leadership
  development opportunities.
* **Address Pressing Regional Issues:** Produce actionable solutions such as policy proposals, joint
  research, articles, and public awareness campaigns.
* **Provide a Sustainable Networking Platform:** Launch an online hub to support ongoing engagement
  and collaborative projects.

The sustainable Blue Economy represents a critical strategic opportunity for Yemen, GCC countries,
and the Red Sea littoral states. At a time when GCC countries are seeking to diversify their
economies away from reliance on oil, the Blue Economy emerges as a vital lifeline for livelihoods
and food security in Yemen, and a key economic leverage for the Red Sea littoral states. Youth in
these regions possess immense potential to lead this transformation, driven by a growing awareness
of sustainability issues and their advanced digital skills.

## Welcome to Omrania!

#### Omrania, part of the Egis Group, is an international architecture and engineering consultancy
#### offering timeless and innovative solutions for a changing world. For nearly half a century,
#### we’ve worked alongside our clients and collaborators to design cities, landscapes, and
#### buildings that respect the environment and build upon local cultural and physical assets.

 

## Our Fingerprints

#### From our headquarters in Riyadh we serve clients all over the world. In addition to completing
#### hundreds of transformative projects across the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia, we have worked in 16
#### other countries in the Middle East, North Africa, and Europe. Click on the different pins on
#### the map below to explore Omrania projects.



## News & Insights

Follow us on Linkedin and social media channels for the latest news and industry insights from

## Two verticals. One roof. No gap to fall through.

Most operators do one thing. Marine agency, or freight forwarding - rarely both, almost never with
the same team and the same accountability. When they're split across vendors, there's a gap between
them that nobody is paid to own. Rapid runs both.

### Marine Agency Services

Vessel permissions, crew handling, shore passes, KSA Visa assistance, supply and husbandry.

For: vessel owners · ship management companies · offshore energy operators

* / Crew sign-on / off, medical at anchorage
* / Ship spares clearance & repair-and-return

Vertical 02

### Logistics & Freight Forwarding

Sea, air and multimodal imports and exports, customs clearance, warehousing and last-mile.

For: importers · exporters · manufacturers · F&B distributors
* / Customs brokerage & duty mitigation
* / Inter-UAE land distribution & GCC green corridors
* / Cold chain & municipality compliance

Cross-border GCC haulage and green-corridor routing via Khorfakkan and Oman when sea lanes tighten.

Straight answers

## The questions clients actually ask.

What does Rapid actually do?+

Two integrated verticals under one roof - marine agency services for vessel owners and ship
managers, and freight forwarding plus customs clearance for importers, exporters and manufacturers.

Which ports do you cover?+

We cover the UAE's major ports and airports, plus air gateways into India:

Sharjah - Port Khalid, Hamriyah Free Zone, Khorfakkan
Dubai - Jebel Ali, Port Rashid, Dubai Maritime City, Dubai Dry Docks
Abu Dhabi - Khalifa Port, Mina Zayed, Musaffah, KIZAD
RAK - Mina Saqr, Khor Port, RAK Maritime City, Al Jazeera, Al Jeer
Air - All UAE international airports + Bangalore (BLR) & Kochi (COK)
Who actually handles my account?+

One named relationship manager, the same point of contact each time, reachable directly. When a
decision is needed, you have direct access to senior management.

Are you the cheapest option?+

No - and not the most expensive either. We're priced competitively against both global corporates
and local agents, and we win on accountability, not on undercutting a rate.

Start the conversation

## Tell us the vessel or the cargo. We'll handle the rest.

One email and a named relationship manager is assigned within the same business day. No onboarding
form, no procurement maze.

Integrated verticals

The structure

## Two verticals. One roof. No gap to fall through.

Most operators do one thing. Marine agency, or freight forwarding - rarely both, almost never with
the same team and the same accountability. When they're split across vendors, there's a gap between
them that nobody is paid to own. Rapid runs both.

Vertical 01

### Marine Agency Services

Vessel permissions, crew handling, shore passes, KSA Visa assistance, supply and husbandry.

For: vessel owners · ship management companies · offshore energy operators
* / Port permissions & Coast Guard coordination
* / Crew sign-on / off, medical at anchorage
* / Ship spares clearance & repair-and-return

Vertical 02

### Logistics & Freight Forwarding

Sea, air and multimodal imports and exports, customs clearance, warehousing and last-mile.

For: importers · exporters · manufacturers · F&B distributors
* / Customs brokerage & duty mitigation
* / Inter-UAE land distribution & GCC green corridors
* / Cold chain & municipality compliance

Track & trace

## Where is my shipment?

Enter your Bill of Lading or container number and pick your carrier. We'll take you straight to the
live tracking for that line. Need eyes on a vessel at anchorage instead? Your relationship manager
has it.

Shipping line Maersk MSC CMA CGM Hapag-Lloyd Ocean Network Express (ONE) COSCO Evergreen Other / not
listed
BoL / Container number
Track

What we handle

## Six capabilities. One point of contact.

[Discuss your requirement][22]
01

### Sea Freight

FCL, LCL and project cargo across the major lines, with customs cleared in step - not as a separate
handoff.

02

### Air Freight

Time-critical and high-value air cargo, including runway-to-chiller handling for perishables.

03

### Land Transport

Cross-border GCC haulage and green-corridor routing via Khorfakkan and Oman when sea lanes tighten.

04

### Warehousing & Distribution

Ambient, chill and frozen storage with last-mile refrigerated delivery and inventory holding.

05

### Customs Brokerage

Clean clearance, repair-and-return deposits and duty mitigation - documentation right the first
time.

06

### Marine Agency

Full port husbandry, crew handling, permissions and supply for vessel owners and managers.

Specialist Services

## Where the standard rate sheet isn't enough.

Some vessels and some cargo don't fit a generic process. These are the lines we run week in, week
out - with the precedents, the contacts and the documentation already in place.

Offshore & energy

### OSV & rig support

The bulk of what we handle. Vessel permissions, crew changes, immigration and supply for offshore
support fleets and rig-bound vessels - across anchorage, supply-boat runs and shore crew.

Cold chain

### F&B culinary logistics

Runway-to-chiller for high-value perishables. MOFA attestations and product registrations filed
ahead of arrival, Dubai Municipality inspection coordinated airside, refrigerated last-mile to the
walk-in.

Technical

### Ship spares & dry-dock

Repair-and-return clearance against dry-dock deadlines. Documentation clean from lodgement, parts
coordinated dockside before the window opens.

Why Rapid

## The real advantage isn't the rate. It's a partner who already knows your vessels, your cargo and
## your history - and never makes you explain twice.

01

### One relationship manager

A named person who knows your fleet, your cargo and your history. Not a queue, not a ticket, not a
rotating desk.

02

### Answers from someone who knows you

Hormuz closed? You get routing options and a quote for each - from the person who already knows your
cargo, not a call centre.

03

### Direct to decision-makers

When a call needs to be made, you reach someone with the authority to make it. The owners stay
personally accountable for the work.

Straight answers

## The questions clients actually ask.

What does Rapid actually do?+

Two integrated verticals under one roof - marine agency services for vessel owners and ship
managers, and freight forwarding plus customs clearance for importers, exporters and manufacturers.

Which ports do you cover?+

We cover the UAE's major ports and airports, plus air gateways into India:

Sharjah - Port Khalid, Hamriyah Free Zone, Khorfakkan
Dubai - Jebel Ali, Port Rashid, Dubai Maritime City, Dubai Dry Docks
Abu Dhabi - Khalifa Port, Mina Zayed, Musaffah, KIZAD
RAK - Mina Saqr, Khor Port, RAK Maritime City, Al Jazeera, Al Jeer
Air - All UAE international airports + Bangalore (BLR) & Kochi (COK)
Who actually handles my account?+

One named relationship manager, the same point of contact each time, reachable directly. When a
decision is needed, you have direct access to senior management.

Are you the cheapest option?+

No - and not the most expensive either. We're priced competitively against both global corporates
and local agents, and we win on accountability, not on undercutting a rate.

Start the conversation

## Tell us the vessel or the cargo. We'll handle the rest.

One email and a named relationship manager is assigned within the same business day. No onboarding
form, no procurement maze.

**SportsMed Performance Trading LLC** is dedicated to getting people moving. We are constantly
researching what is new in the market and always looking to uncover new technologies that will aid
rehabilitation or improve performance.

We began as employees of AlterG over 15 years ago managing the launch of AlterG Anti-Gravity
Treadmills in Europe. With the creation of [SportsMed Products Ltd][125] in the UK and Ireland in
2015 we have since expanded to take on distribution of various products. 

Launching in January 2025 in the GCC, we saw a gap in the market to provide long term partnerships
with our customers with full training provided on all of our products and ongoing servicing to
ensure your equipment is utilised fully.

We are now the Authorised Distributor by AlterG for the GCC region. Contact us to find out more
about our full range of products including [AlterG][126], [HUR][127] & [Pulse Fitness][128]

### AlterG

AlterG Anti Gravity Treadmills. A weightless physiotherapy experience for all ages, whether you are
looking to train or in rehabilitation.

Well-proven exercising concepts for senior exercise, rehabilitation and wellness.

**SportsMed Performance Trading LLC** is dedicated to getting people moving. We are constantly
researching what is new in the market and always looking to uncover new technologies that will aid
rehabilitation or improve performance.

We began as employees of AlterG over 15 years ago managing the launch of AlterG Anti-Gravity
Treadmills in Europe. With the creation of [SportsMed Products Ltd][125] in the UK and Ireland in
2015 we have since expanded to take on distribution of various products. 

Launching in January 2025 in the GCC, we saw a gap in the market to provide long term partnerships
with our customers with full training provided on all of our products and ongoing servicing to
ensure your equipment is utilised fully.

We are now the Authorised Distributor by AlterG for the GCC region. Contact us to find out more
about our full range of products including [AlterG][126], [HUR][127] & [Pulse Fitness][128]

   **Effective Date: 9/9/25**
   
   The Rag Company is committed to shipping your order quickly, safely, and affordably. Please
   review the details of our shipping policy below.
   
    
   
   **Shipping Coverage**
   
   We currently ship only within the United States, including:
   
   Alaska and Hawaii
   
   State-side APO/FPO addresses
   
   We do not ship internationally. If you are located outside the U.S., please visit our Distributor
   Page to find an authorized reseller in your region.
   
    
   
   **Processing Time**
   
   Most orders are processed and shipped within 48 hours of being received.
   
   During peak sale times can extend the time it takes us to process the orders.
   
   Orders are shipped Monday through Saturday (excluding holidays).
   
   Delivery timeframes begin once the carrier picks up the order from our warehouse.
   
    
   
   **Shipping Rates**
   
   Flat Rate: $9.99 for orders under $115 (pre-tax, after discounts).
   
   Free Shipping: Orders $115 and above (pre-tax, after discounts).
   
   Rates are applied automatically at checkout.
   
    
   
   **Carriers & Methods**
   
   USPS Priority Mail (2–3 days) is our primary shipping method.
   
   USPS Parcel Select or UPS may be used at our discretion if more cost-effective.
   
   Shipping times vary by carrier and destination; we cannot guarantee specific delivery dates.
   
    
   
   **Tracking Information**
   
   A tracking number will be emailed once your order leaves our warehouse.
   
   Please check your spam/junk folders if you do not see the email.
   
   Incorrect or missing email addresses will prevent tracking updates.
   
    
   
   **Delivery & Liability**
   
   Most packages are delivered without requiring a signature. Drivers may leave packages at their
   discretion.
   
   A “signature required” service is available by request for an additional fee.
   
   Once a package is delivered to the shipping address provided, The Rag Company is not responsible
   for lost, stolen, or misdelivered packages.
   
   Customers are responsible for providing accurate and complete shipping information at checkout.
   
    
   
   **Questions**
   
   If you have any questions about shipping or need assistance with your order, please contact us at
   support@theragcompany.com.

# WinLibs.com

## WinLibs standalone build of GCC and MinGW-w64 for Windows

Jump to:   [Download][1] | [How to use from Windows Command Prompt][2] | [How to use from
Code::Blocks][3] | [Philosophy][4] | [Donate][5]

### What is it?

In short: it's a free C and C++ compiler for Microsoft Windows.

[GCC][6] (GNU Compiler Collection) is a free and open source compiler for C and C++ (and other
languages like Objective-C, Fortran, D).
[MinGW-w64][7] is a free and open source C library for targetting Windows 32-bit and 64-bit
platforms.
The combination of these results in a free C/C++ compiler for Windows.
Even though GCC and MinGW-w64 can be used on other platforms (e.g. Linux) to generate Windows
executables, the WinLibs project only focusses on building versions that run natively on Windows.

Also some additional tools are added, including:
* [GDB][8] - the GNU Project debugger
* [GNU Binutils][9] - a collection of binary tools
* [GNU Make][10] - a tool which controls the generation of executables and other non-source files
* [Yasm][11] - The Yasm Modular Assembler Project
* [NASM][12] - The Netwide Assembler
* [JWasm][13] - A free MASM-compatible assembler
* [LLVM/Clang/LLD/LLDB][14] - The LLVM Compiler Infrastructure

This is a standalone build, which means this download offers a complete compiler environment for
Windows.

In the future WinLibs plans to also release binary packages of many open source libraries and
applications built with this compiler.

Click [here][15] to see the philosophy and design decisions behind [winlibs.com][16].

### Who is it for?

WinLibs could be just what you are looking in these case:
* You are using Microsoft Windows and want to start programming in C and/or C++ using completely
  free software.
  To get started more easily you should probably use an IDE like [Code::Blocks][17].
* You have written software using another proprietary compiler (like Microsoft Visual C/C++ and
  Visual Studio) and would like to test if your application compiles using the the most common C/C++
  compiler available: GCC.
* You have written software for Windows but would like to port it to other plaftorms (like Linux or
  Apple macOS).
  When using the MSYS2 command line you get access to most command line tools that are also
  available on those other platforms (like GNU Autotools), allowing you create standard build
  instructions across platforms (like: ./configure && make && make install).
  Another way of configuring your build for each platform is by using [CMake][18], which is also
  available for many platforms (including Windows).
* You are used to developing for another platform like Linux or Apple macOS and would like to start
  programming for Windows.
  If you use MSYS2 you won't have to learn any new commands. Or if your existing project(s) already
  use configuration tools like GNU Autotools or [CMake][19] you can start building for Windows in no
  time.
* You are C++ developer who can't wait to try out the latest C++ standard.
  GCC is always very quick to implement new C++ standards. You may even want to consider using the
  latest snapshot version.

### Threading library

GCC for Windows can be built with the follwing threading libraries:
* **POSIX** (best compatibility with other platforms)
* WIN32 (native Windows thread but misses POSIX threads / pthread.h)
* MCF (since GCC 13, see also: [MCF Gthread Library][20])

For portability reasons (compatibility with other platforms) the builds published here use the POSIX
threading library.
Since GCC 13 some builds with the MCF threading model were also released.

### MSVCRT or UCRT runtime library?

Traditionally the MinGW-w64 compiler used **MSVCRT** as runtime library, which is available on all
versions of Windows.

Since Windows 10 Universal C Runtime (**UCRT**) is available as an alternative to MSVCRT.
Universal C Runtime can also be installed on earlier versions of Windows (see: [Update for Universal
C Runtime in Windows][21]).

Unless you are targetting older versions of Windows, UCRT as runtime library is the better choice,
as it was written to better support recent Windows versions as well as provide better standards
conformance (see also: [Upgrade your code to the Universal CRT][22]).

### Download

The following downloads are available (for Windows only).
*You will need a decompressor like [7-Zip][23] (free) to unzip .7z archives, but they are a lot
smaller than .zip files.

Each version comes in 2 flavors:
* Win32 - i686 - Windows 32-bit version, runs natively on and compiles for Windows 32-bit (also runs
  on Windows 64-bit, but in 32-bit mode)
* Win64 - x86_64 - Windows 64-bit version, runs natively on and compiles for Windows 64-bit (will
  not run on Windows 32-bit)

#### Help! I don't know which download to choose!

Don't worry. For most purposes the latest Windows 64-bit release version with MSVCRT runtime and
POSIX threads is a good choice.

Download it [here][24].

#### Release versions

##### UCRT runtime
* GCC 16.1

# WinLibs.com

## WinLibs standalone build of GCC and MinGW-w64 for Windows

Jump to:   [Download][1] | [How to use from Windows Command Prompt][2] | [How to use from
Code::Blocks][3] | [Philosophy][4] | [Donate][5]

### What is it?

In short: it's a free C and C++ compiler for Microsoft Windows.

[GCC][6] (GNU Compiler Collection) is a free and open source compiler for C and C++ (and other
languages like Objective-C, Fortran, D).
[MinGW-w64][7] is a free and open source C library for targetting Windows 32-bit and 64-bit
platforms.
The combination of these results in a free C/C++ compiler for Windows.
Even though GCC and MinGW-w64 can be used on other platforms (e.g. Linux) to generate Windows
executables, the WinLibs project only focusses on building versions that run natively on Windows.

Also some additional tools are added, including:
* [GDB][8] - the GNU Project debugger
* [GNU Binutils][9] - a collection of binary tools
* [GNU Make][10] - a tool which controls the generation of executables and other non-source files
* [Yasm][11] - The Yasm Modular Assembler Project
* [NASM][12] - The Netwide Assembler
* [JWasm][13] - A free MASM-compatible assembler
* [LLVM/Clang/LLD/LLDB][14] - The LLVM Compiler Infrastructure

This is a standalone build, which means this download offers a complete compiler environment for
Windows.

In the future WinLibs plans to also release binary packages of many open source libraries and
applications built with this compiler.

Click [here][15] to see the philosophy and design decisions behind [winlibs.com][16].

### Who is it for?

WinLibs could be just what you are looking in these case:
* You are using Microsoft Windows and want to start programming in C and/or C++ using completely
  free software.
  To get started more easily you should probably use an IDE like [Code::Blocks][17].
* You have written software using another proprietary compiler (like Microsoft Visual C/C++ and
  Visual Studio) and would like to test if your application compiles using the the most common C/C++
  compiler available: GCC.
* You have written software for Windows but would like to port it to other plaftorms (like Linux or
  Apple macOS).
  When using the MSYS2 command line you get access to most command line tools that are also
  available on those other platforms (like GNU Autotools), allowing you create standard build
  instructions across platforms (like: ./configure && make && make install).
  Another way of configuring your build for each platform is by using [CMake][18], which is also
  available for many platforms (including Windows).
* You are used to developing for another platform like Linux or Apple macOS and would like to start
  programming for Windows.
  If you use MSYS2 you won't have to learn any new commands. Or if your existing project(s) already
  use configuration tools like GNU Autotools or [CMake][19] you can start building for Windows in no
  time.
* You are C++ developer who can't wait to try out the latest C++ standard.
  GCC is always very quick to implement new C++ standards. You may even want to consider using the
  latest snapshot version.

### Threading library

GCC for Windows can be built with the follwing threading libraries:
* **POSIX** (best compatibility with other platforms)
* WIN32 (native Windows thread but misses POSIX threads / pthread.h)
* MCF (since GCC 13, see also: [MCF Gthread Library][20])

For portability reasons (compatibility with other platforms) the builds published here use the POSIX
threading library.
Since GCC 13 some builds with the MCF threading model were also released.

### MSVCRT or UCRT runtime library?

Traditionally the MinGW-w64 compiler used **MSVCRT** as runtime library, which is available on all
versions of Windows.

Since Windows 10 Universal C Runtime (**UCRT**) is available as an alternative to MSVCRT.
Universal C Runtime can also be installed on earlier versions of Windows (see: [Update for Universal
C Runtime in Windows][21]).

Unless you are targetting older versions of Windows, UCRT as runtime library is the better choice,
as it was written to better support recent Windows versions as well as provide better standards
conformance (see also: [Upgrade your code to the Universal CRT][22]).

### Download

The following downloads are available (for Windows only).
*You will need a decompressor like [7-Zip][23] (free) to unzip .7z archives, but they are a lot
smaller than .zip files.

Each version comes in 2 flavors:
* Win32 - i686 - Windows 32-bit version, runs natively on and compiles for Windows 32-bit (also runs
  on Windows 64-bit, but in 32-bit mode)
* Win64 - x86_64 - Windows 64-bit version, runs natively on and compiles for Windows 64-bit (will
  not run on Windows 32-bit)

#### Help! I don't know which download to choose!

Don't worry. For most purposes the latest Windows 64-bit release version with MSVCRT runtime and
POSIX threads is a good choice.

Download it [here][24].

#### Release versions

##### UCRT runtime

## „Numbers don't lie“

A saying that is unfortunately questioned far too rarely. The bare figures are, of course, true, but
they are packaged differently and often collected or interpreted differently on a global level.
Nevertheless, they give the impression of being incorruptible and binding. But how is all this data
generated?

Let's take [land area][82] as a simple example. One would think that such mundane data would be an
easy task in this age of satellites and GPS-based land surveying. Far from it. There are so many
different calculation methods that even die-hard statisticians get confused. At what width is a
river deducted from the land mass? The most common source for such figures is Google. But that is
precisely where there is no reference to the source or explanation of the calculation method. It is
assumed that Google uses its own map service for this. Whether or when 2- or 3-dimensional models
are used here is not apparent. With a 3D model, the surface area would also be measured correctly on
mountain slopes.
Google's data often corresponds with that of the World Bank, which usually takes several years to
obtain the data from the United Nations. This is probably the most official source, but it only
reproduces information from the FAO, which in turn obtains all its data from external sources. The
term "imputed by a receiving agency" usually refers to the country itself. As in many other areas of
statistics, questionnaires are sent to each country annually. Those who do not fill them out are
simply estimated. External agencies may also be responsible for these estimates. These figures are
then included in the statistics under the heading "figure from external organization." If there are
territorial disputes, such as in the Indian-Pakistani border regions, large areas are often claimed
twice.

The situation is even worse when it comes to [unemployment figures][83], which are calculated
differently in virtually every country. In many western industrialized countries, people who are
undergoing further training precisely because they are unemployed are no longer considered
unemployed. Such tricks are used in many countries. The ILOEST system attempts to bring all this
down to a common, cross-border denominator. The figures differ significantly from those reported by
the countries themselves. But this system also has weaknesses because it requires countless
additional data that can often only be vaguely estimated. In addition, poorer countries in
particular offer no incentives to register as unemployed. If there is no state pension, no health
insurance, and no unemployment benefits, people do not register as unemployed. Why should they?

The **financial sector** is probably the best documented topic. But what turnover can a state
measure (or tax) when someone exchanges a sack of rice for a few pounds of meat, which they then use
to pay for vegetables at the nearest corner shop? These are all cash-equivalent transactions in an
informal economic cycle, but they bypass any statistical system. There are countless regions around
the world where trade works in exactly this way. The International Labor Organization estimates that
around 2 billion people worldwide lived like this in 2019. That is about 60% of the global
workforce. This phenomenon is particularly prevalent in poorer countries, meaning that statistics
can only be based on rough estimates.

The sensible use of tax money is debatable. But [comparing tax rates][84] is even more so. We have a
comparison of income taxes and levies per country. But what does this figure say in comparison to
other countries? Statutory health insurance, pension systems, social assistance, unemployment
benefits, and even the provision of kindergarten places are regulated differently in each country
and are virtually impossible to compare. However, they are all financed by tax money.

Comparisons of [height][85] or [intelligence][86] often lead to open hostility. These are mostly
summaries of studies conducted by doctors, educational or health organizations. When hundreds or
thousands of these studies are summarized, a comparable picture emerges across countries. There can
be no claim to completeness or universal truth here.

It is often helpful to look behind the numbers. This not only shows what was collected and how, but
also provides a connection to real life.

## „Numbers don't lie“

A saying that is unfortunately questioned far too rarely. The bare figures are, of course, true, but
they are packaged differently and often collected or interpreted differently on a global level.
Nevertheless, they give the impression of being incorruptible and binding. But how is all this data
generated?

Let's take [land area][82] as a simple example. One would think that such mundane data would be an
easy task in this age of satellites and GPS-based land surveying. Far from it. There are so many
different calculation methods that even die-hard statisticians get confused. At what width is a
river deducted from the land mass? The most common source for such figures is Google. But that is
precisely where there is no reference to the source or explanation of the calculation method. It is
assumed that Google uses its own map service for this. Whether or when 2- or 3-dimensional models
are used here is not apparent. With a 3D model, the surface area would also be measured correctly on
mountain slopes.
Google's data often corresponds with that of the World Bank, which usually takes several years to
obtain the data from the United Nations. This is probably the most official source, but it only
reproduces information from the FAO, which in turn obtains all its data from external sources. The
term "imputed by a receiving agency" usually refers to the country itself. As in many other areas of
statistics, questionnaires are sent to each country annually. Those who do not fill them out are
simply estimated. External agencies may also be responsible for these estimates. These figures are
then included in the statistics under the heading "figure from external organization." If there are
territorial disputes, such as in the Indian-Pakistani border regions, large areas are often claimed
twice.

The situation is even worse when it comes to [unemployment figures][83], which are calculated
differently in virtually every country. In many western industrialized countries, people who are
undergoing further training precisely because they are unemployed are no longer considered
unemployed. Such tricks are used in many countries. The ILOEST system attempts to bring all this
down to a common, cross-border denominator. The figures differ significantly from those reported by
the countries themselves. But this system also has weaknesses because it requires countless
additional data that can often only be vaguely estimated. In addition, poorer countries in
particular offer no incentives to register as unemployed. If there is no state pension, no health
insurance, and no unemployment benefits, people do not register as unemployed. Why should they?

The **financial sector** is probably the best documented topic. But what turnover can a state
measure (or tax) when someone exchanges a sack of rice for a few pounds of meat, which they then use
to pay for vegetables at the nearest corner shop? These are all cash-equivalent transactions in an
informal economic cycle, but they bypass any statistical system. There are countless regions around
the world where trade works in exactly this way. The International Labor Organization estimates that
around 2 billion people worldwide lived like this in 2019. That is about 60% of the global
workforce. This phenomenon is particularly prevalent in poorer countries, meaning that statistics
can only be based on rough estimates.

The sensible use of tax money is debatable. But [comparing tax rates][84] is even more so. We have a
comparison of income taxes and levies per country. But what does this figure say in comparison to
other countries? Statutory health insurance, pension systems, social assistance, unemployment
benefits, and even the provision of kindergarten places are regulated differently in each country
and are virtually impossible to compare. However, they are all financed by tax money.

Comparisons of [height][85] or [intelligence][86] often lead to open hostility. These are mostly
summaries of studies conducted by doctors, educational or health organizations. When hundreds or
thousands of these studies are summarized, a comparable picture emerges across countries. There can
be no claim to completeness or universal truth here.

It is often helpful to look behind the numbers. This not only shows what was collected and how, but
also provides a connection to real life.
